predecessor.disposition: Predecessor byte and page-shell hash measurements remain historical at its tested commit. The five non-page-shell mutations in the original M11 record remain bound to unchanged source blobs.

mutation.command: npx vitest run --project @syzygy/three-surface-poc-app --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --testTimeout=60000 apps/three-surface-poc/src/response-limits.test.ts -t 'places one compact factual status line' --reporter=dot

privateDaemonMeasurement.method: Clean committed head; private daemon on port 0 and disposable state directory; HTTP requests counted UTF-8 response bytes. Tailnet request used the exact Host header. The daemon was SIGTERM-closed and state directory removed after measurement; no live POC listener or port 7478 was touched.
